title: My Uncle’s “Secret”
synopsis: Find out what the author’s uncle is hiding, and how his family reacts when they find out.

fullText.simplified:
舅舅的“秘密”

    我姥姥一共生了两个孩子，我妈妈和我舅舅。我妈妈从小就是个乖孩子，学习好，脾气好，从来没让我姥姥着过急。我舅舅就不一样了，他聪明是聪明，但是小时候淘气，到处给我姥姥惹事，长大后，也不让家里人省心。用我姥姥的话来说就是“整天瞎折腾”。
    舅舅大学毕业后，就在我们当地的政府部门工作。舅舅聪明，情商高，他的领导和同事都非常喜欢他。姥姥也十分欣慰，她常常跟我妈妈说：“你弟弟工作后表现不错，回头再找个女朋友结个婚，我就踏实啦。”
    但是，老老实实工作根本就不是我舅舅的风格，他常挂在嘴边的话是：“生命不息，折腾不止。”这不，最近舅舅又开始“作妖”了。
    前两天，舅舅一个办公室的同事给姥姥打来电话，询问舅舅身体怎么样了？姥姥听了同事的话觉得有点莫名其妙，仔细一问才知道舅舅已经一个多月没去上班了，跟单位请了假说是需要做个手术。姥姥跟舅舅的同事客气了几句就挂了电话，急急忙忙地去找我妈妈，一见到我妈妈就生气地说：“东子这个小兔崽子，骗我说单位让他去外地出差一个月，结果根本不是这么回事，刚才他单位同事来电话说他跟单位请假做手术去了。你说他两头骗，他到底干什么去了。”我妈听了姥姥的话，先是劝姥姥别生气，然后赶紧给舅舅打电话，结果打了半天不是没人接，就是没信号。妈妈只好先让姥姥回家等消息，她去舅舅的朋友那儿问问情况。
    妈妈问了一圈，终于在舅舅的好哥们强子叔叔那儿问出了舅舅的去向。原来，舅舅瞒着所有人去了山区支教。那里山高路远，为了不让家人担心，他就说了谎。而且，妈妈还听到一个更惊人的消息，那就是舅舅在几天前辞职了，他决定在山区支教三年。
    妈妈听完气得话都说不出来了。她不知道怎么把这件事情告诉我姥姥。说实话吧，怕姥姥生气，不说实话吧，又实在想不出什么别的办法。最后，我妈妈硬着头皮把舅舅辞职去山区支教的事告诉了姥姥。出乎意料的是，这次姥姥不但没生气，还笑着说：“这小子终于做了一次最正确的决定。给他打电话，告诉他我百分之百支持他。”
    回家以后，妈妈跟爸爸聊起了舅舅的事情，也把姥姥的话讲给了爸爸听。爸爸说：“你妈妈有大智慧，懂教育。你看你弟弟就知道了，你总说你弟弟不能踏踏实实过日子，但是你发现没有？他做的每件事、每个决定都不出格，而且还都是对社会有益的。”
    听了爸爸的话，我心想：“原来舅舅不是不务正业呀，而是一个非常有想法的人。我要向他学习。”
fullText.traditional:
舅舅的“秘密”

    我姥姥一共生了兩個孩子，我媽媽和我舅舅。我媽媽從小就是個乖孩子，學習好，脾氣好，從來沒讓我姥姥著過急。我舅舅就不一樣了，他聰明是聰明，但是小時候淘氣，到處給我姥姥惹事，長大後，也不讓家裡人省心。用我姥姥的話來說就是“整天瞎折騰”。
    舅舅大學畢業後，就在我們當地的政府部門工作。舅舅聰明，情商高，他的領導和同事都非常喜歡他。姥姥也十分欣慰，她常常跟我媽媽說：“你弟弟工作後表現不錯，回頭再找個女朋友結個婚，我就踏實啦。”
    但是，老老實實工作根本就不是我舅舅的風格，他常掛在嘴邊的話是：“生命不息，折騰不止。”這不，最近舅舅又開始“作妖”了。
    前兩天，舅舅一個辦公室的同事給姥姥打來電話，詢問舅舅身體怎麼樣了？姥姥聽了同事的話覺得有點莫名其妙，仔細一問才知道舅舅已經一個多月沒去上班了，跟單位請了假說是需要做個手術。姥姥跟舅舅的同事客氣了幾句就掛了電話，急急忙忙地去找我媽媽，一見到我媽媽就生氣地說：“東子這個小兔崽子，騙我說單位讓他去外地出差一個月，結果根本不是這麼回事，剛才他單位同事來電話說他跟單位請假做手術去了。你說他兩頭騙，他到底幹什麼去了。”我媽聽了姥姥的話，先是勸姥姥別生氣，然後趕緊給舅舅打電話，結果打了半天不是沒人接，就是沒信號。媽媽只好先讓姥姥回家等消息，她去舅舅的朋友那兒問問情況。
    媽媽問了一圈，終於在舅舅的好哥們強子叔叔那兒問出了舅舅的去向。原來，舅舅瞞著所有人去了山區支教。那裡山高路遠，為了不讓家人擔心，他就說了謊。而且，媽媽還聽到一個更驚人的消息，那就是舅舅在幾天前辭職了，他決定在山區支教三年。
    媽媽聽完氣得話都說不出來了。她不知道怎麼把這件事情告訴我姥姥。說實話吧，怕姥姥生氣，不說實話吧，又實在想不出什麼別的辦法。最後，我媽媽硬著頭皮把舅舅辭職去山區支教的事告訴了姥姥。出乎意料的是，這次姥姥不但沒生氣，還笑著說：“這小子終於做了一次最正確的決定。給他打電話，告訴他我百分之百支持他。”
    回家以後，媽媽跟爸爸聊起了舅舅的事情，也把姥姥的話講給了爸爸聽。爸爸說：“你媽媽有大智慧，懂教育。你看你弟弟就知道了，你總說你弟弟不能踏踏實實過日子，但是你發現沒有？他做的每件事、每個決定都不出格，而且還都是對社會有益的。”
    聽了爸爸的話，我心想：“原來舅舅不是不務正業呀，而是一個非常有想法的人。我要向他學習。”

sentences.traditional: 不說實話吧，又實在想不出什麼別的辦法。
sentences.pinyin: bù shuō shí huà ba yòu shí zài xiǎng bù chū shén me bié de bàn fǎ
sentences.english: She was afraid that my grandma would be angry if she told the truth.

sentences.simplified: 最后，我妈妈硬着头皮把舅舅辞职去山区支教的事告诉了姥姥。
sentences.traditional: 最後，我媽媽硬著頭皮把舅舅辭職去山區支教的事告訴了姥姥。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu wǒ mā ma yìng zhe tóu pí bǎ jiù jiu cí zhí qù shān qū zhī jiào de shì gào su le lǎo lao
sentences.english: But she couldn’t think of what else she could do if she didn’t tell the truth.

sentences.simplified: 出乎意料的是，这次姥姥不但没生气，还笑着说：“这小子终于做了一次最正确的决定。
sentences.traditional: 出乎意料的是，這次姥姥不但沒生氣，還笑著說：“這小子終於做了一次最正確的決定。
sentences.pinyin: chū hū yì liào de shì zhè cì lǎo lao bú dàn méi shēng qì hái xiào zhe shuō zhè xiǎo zi zhōng yú zuò le yí cì zuì zhèng què de jué dìng
sentences.english: Finally, my mother braced herself and told my grandma that my uncle had quit his job and gone to teach as a volunteer in a mountainous area.

sentences.simplified: 给他打电话，告诉他我百分之百支持他。”
sentences.traditional: 給他打電話，告訴他我百分之百支持他。”
sentences.pinyin: gěi tā dǎ diàn huà gào su tā wǒ bǎi fēn zhī bǎi zhī chí tā
sentences.english: Unexpectedly, this time, not only was my grandma not angry, she smiled and said, “This kid has finally made a correct decision for once.
Give him a call and tell him that I support him 100%.”

sentences.simplified: 回家以后，妈妈跟爸爸聊起了舅舅的事情，
sentences.traditional: 回家以後，媽媽跟爸爸聊起了舅舅的事情，
sentences.pinyin: huí jiā yǐ hòu mā ma gēn bà ba liáo qǐ le jiù jiu de shì qing

sentences.simplified: 也把姥姥的话讲给了爸爸听。
sentences.traditional: 也把姥姥的話講給了爸爸聽。
sentences.pinyin: yě bǎ lǎo lao de huà jiǎng gěi le bà ba tīng
sentences.english: When my mother was chatting with my father after she got home, she brought up my uncle’s situation.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸说：“你妈妈有大智慧，懂教育。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸說：“你媽媽有大智慧，懂教育。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba shuō nǐ mā ma yǒu dà zhì huì dǒng jiào yù
sentences.english: She also told him what my grandma had said.

sentences.simplified: 你看你弟弟就知道了，你总说你弟弟不能踏踏实实过日子，但是你发现没有？
sentences.traditional: 你看你弟弟就知道了，你總說你弟弟不能踏踏實實過日子，但是你發現沒有？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kàn nǐ dì di jiù zhī dào le nǐ zǒng shuō nǐ dì di bù néng tā tā shí shí guò rì zi dàn shì nǐ fā xiàn méi yǒu
sentences.english: My father said, “Your mother has great wisdom and understands education.

sentences.simplified: 他做的每件事、每个决定都不出格，
sentences.traditional: 他做的每件事、每個決定都不出格，
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò de měi jiàn shì měi ge jué dìng dōu bù chū gé
sentences.english: Just look at your younger brother. You always say that your brother can’t keep stability in his life, but have you noticed?

sentences.simplified: 而且还都是对社会有益的。”
sentences.traditional: 而且還都是對社會有益的。”
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě hái dōu shì duì shè huì yǒu yì de
sentences.english: Everything that he’s done, all of the decisions that he’s made, nothing overstepped the mark, ..
.. and everything has contributed positively to society.”

sentences.simplified: 听了爸爸的话，我心想：“原来舅舅不是不务正业呀，
sentences.traditional: 聽了爸爸的話，我心想：“原來舅舅不是不務正業呀，
sentences.pinyin: tīng le bà ba de huà wǒ xīn xiǎng yuán lái jiù jiu bú shì bú wù zhèng yè ya

sentences.simplified: 而是一个非常有想法的人。我要向他学习。”
sentences.traditional: 而是一個非常有想法的人。我要向他學習。”
sentences.pinyin: ér shì yí ge fēi cháng yǒu xiǎng fǎ de rén wǒ yào xiàng tā xué xí
sentences.english: After hearing what my father said, I thought to myself, “It turns out that my uncle isn’t just messing around.

sentence_translations: My Uncle’s “Secret”
My grandma has two children, my mother and my uncle.
My mother was always a good kid. She was a good student and had a good temper. She never made my grandma worry.
My uncle was different. He was intelligent, but he was a naughty kid and was always causing my grandma trouble.
Now that he’s an adult, he still gives the family reasons to worry.
In the words of my grandma, he “messes around all day”.
After graduating from university, my uncle began working for our local government.
My uncle is smart and emotionally intelligent. His boss and his coworkers liked him a lot.
My grandma was very pleased. She often told my mother, “Your younger brother has been doing quite well after he started working.
If he can find a girlfriend and get married, then I will have peace of mind.
However, working a steady job was not my uncle’s style at all.
He often said, “Seek adventure as long as you live.” As a matter of fact, my uncle has started “causing havoc” again.
A couple of days ago, one of my uncle’s coworkers called my grandma and asked about my uncle’s health.
My grandma was quite puzzled when she heard what the coworker said.
It was only after closer questioning that she learned that my uncle hadn’t been to work in over a month.
He had taken leave from the work unit, saying that he had to have surgery.
My grandma hung up after saying a few polite words to my uncle’s coworker and then hurriedly went to look for my mother.
As soon as she saw my mother, she said to her angrily, “Dong, that little rascal.
He lied to me, saying that the work unit sent him on a business trip for a month.
It turns out that that is not the case at all. His coworker just called me saying he took leave from the work unit to get surgery.
Look, he is lying to both sides. What the hell is he doing?”
After listening to my grandma speak, my mother first told my grandma not to be angry and then called my uncle right away.
She called for a long time, and either no one picked up, or there was no signal.
My mother could only tell my grandma to go home and wait for an update, ..
.. while she went around to my uncle’s friends to ask what was happening.
After asking around, my mother finally found out my uncle’s whereabouts from his friend, Uncle Qiang.
It turns out that my uncle had gone to teach as a volunteer in a mountainous area.
The location was far away in the high mountains, so he lied in order to keep his family from worrying.
Moreover, my mother heard even more shocking news, which was that my uncle quit his job a few days ago.
He decided to teach as a volunteer in the mountainous area for three years.
After hearing this, my mother was so angry she was at a loss for words.
She didn’t know how to tell my grandma about such a thing.
She was afraid that my grandma would be angry if she told the truth.
But she couldn’t think of what else she could do if she didn’t tell the truth.
Finally, my mother braced herself and told my grandma that my uncle had quit his job and gone to teach as a volunteer in a mountainous area.
Unexpectedly, this time, not only was my grandma not angry, she smiled and said, “This kid has finally made a correct decision for once.
Give him a call and tell him that I support him 100%.”
When my mother was chatting with my father after she got home, she brought up my uncle’s situation.
She also told him what my grandma had said.
My father said, “Your mother has great wisdom and understands education.
Just look at your younger brother. You always say that your brother can’t keep stability in his life, but have you noticed?
Everything that he’s done, all of the decisions that he’s made, nothing overstepped the mark, ..
.. and everything has contributed positively to society.”
After hearing what my father said, I thought to myself, “It turns out that my uncle isn’t just messing around.
On the contrary, he is someone with his own ideas. I should learn from him.”
